rule: Select one primary packet. Actual proof dependencies and status require original evidence; upstream lists are advisory. Review nominees recuse if contributors.

assignments.target_statement: Write the exact all-dimensions FEI target, inventory every sufficient condition in both recovered manuscripts, and identify its first unproved implication. Separate equivalence, one-way reduction, and proved class theorem.

deliverables.description: TARGET_QUANTIFIERS.md: theorem-by-theorem all-dimensions and all-bias quantifier table
GAP_MAP.json: first open implication for each manuscript route

acceptance_criteria: State one finite C independent of dimension for all nonconstant Boolean signs, and handle constants without dividing by I=0.

Classify the universal witness residual as sufficient, the good-coordinate endpoint as equivalent in finiteness, and the fixed-cyclic conditional completion as FEI-strength; do not identify their optimal constants without proof.
Pin each proved baseline to its complete source; reject a dependency edge whose only justification is the desired universal FEI conclusion.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A complete source-pinned gap table closes this baseline packet; future work goes to the first open lemma rather than repeatedly rebuilding the table.

assignments.target_statement: Reprove the tensor, balancing, sparse-activation, and auxiliary coding ledgers. Determine which extra hypotheses survive each transformation and which proposed restricted endpoints still contain arbitrary tensor factors.

deliverables.description: TRANSFORMATION_LEDGER.tex: tensor, balancing, activation, and coding identities
HYPOTHESIS_SURVIVAL.json: exact properties retained or lost by each transformation

acceptance_criteria: Give the truth-table or circuit transformation, new dimension, H, I, mean, and parameter restrictions for every ledger entry.
Explicitly display the arbitrary seed and tensor-count limit in both two-cell selector and low-influence/full-support admission tests.
Separate physical input independence from correlated spectral coordinates, and include the influence cost of all new variables.
assignments.renewal_milestone: All four transformations are reusable with exact hypotheses; send any genuinely missing stability estimate to A013 or A055.

assignments.target_statement: Compare the witness residual, good-coordinate erasure, and signed-Booleanity targets. Produce a formally explicit implication diagram with constants and a smallest genuinely stronger lemma for each route.

deliverables.description: OPEN_LEMMAS.json: distinct missing estimates and their scopes

acceptance_criteria: Write the full J residual including posterior entropy and root conditioning, and the R criterion with relevant-coordinate quantifier.
Draw the proof implication graph independently of the advisory packet graph; an arrow must carry a proved derivation or be marked open.
For each proposed minimal lemma, test arbitrary tensor-factor admission and explain what quantitative statement is stronger than merely restating FEI.
assignments.renewal_milestone: Every route has a dispatchable unpaid inequality with defined symbols and no circular assumed input.

assignments.target_statement: Normalize bits versus natural logarithms, sign functions versus indicators, total versus directional influence, and empty versus nonempty entropy. Check every imported inequality at constant, dictator, parity, and nearly constant endpoints.

deliverables.description: CONVENTIONS.json: sign/indicator, logarithm, influence, variance, and entropy mappings
ENDPOINT_CHECKS.md: constant, dictator, character, and rare-output calculations

acceptance_criteria: Convert each numerical constant with the correct ln2 factor; distinguish Shannon entropy of a normalized law from raw entropy of a subprobability.
Evaluate I−Var, empty-atom contributions, and bias endpoints without taking a logarithm of zero.
Check character multiplication using D(f)=min_U I(χ_U f) and confirm that this operation preserves H but not generally I.
assignments.renewal_milestone: One audited convention ledger is frozen and reused; numerical constant polishing is not a continuing assignment.

assignments.target_statement: Attempt to embed an arbitrary Boolean seed into every supposedly easier universal endpoint. Supply the embedding and limit when it exists; otherwise identify the precise obstruction and ask for its proof.

deliverables.description: ENDPOINT_ADMISSION_TESTS.tex: explicit arbitrary-seed embeddings or failed admission conditions
SCOPE_VERDICTS.json: equivalent, sufficient, restricted, or unresolved labels

acceptance_criteria: For every accepted embedding, identify the seed, balancing variables, tensor order, and limit that recovers H(seed)/I(seed).
A claim that the embedding fails must point to a proved class hypothesis violated by the actual construction, not a newly assumed exclusion.
Do not treat a finite violation of a candidate K or a local surcharge as a disproof of universal FEI.
assignments.renewal_milestone: Resolve at least one live endpoint's hardness status; reuse already settled embeddings and move to a distinct class condition.
